item.title: The Meeting — Graham and the Great Tea Crisis
item.description: Graham runs out of teabags mid-meeting. What follows is a crisis of national proportions, a queue at the corner shop, and an accidental unmute that derails the entire agenda into retail economics.

item.title: The Meeting — Nigel and the Grocery Run
item.description: During an endless Teams meeting, Nigel discovers that nobody is really paying attention — until a self-checkout machine betrays him.

item.title: The Meeting — Rebecca and the Lighting Strategy
item.description: Rebecca leaves a tedious meeting to collect a parcel. She ordered one lamp. Six spill out on the pavement. The meeting is listening. Corporate logic does the rest.
